title: Draft: Update packet-ansi_tcap-template.c
description: This merge completes the missing TCAP dissector, specifically for TCAP parameters. If you look into wireshark/epan/dissectors/asn1/ansi_tcap/packet-ansi_tcap-template.c, you will see a TODO of handling national codes. I created the dissector tables and called for them appropriately.

notes.body: The table must en switch a 0, NULL entry
Use proto_tree_add_item everywhere and not proto_tree_add_rext_internal which should not be used
We have functions that handle automatically the BCD encoding, no need to do it manually

Can you point me to what I should be doing instead and how I would use proto_tree_add_item instead? The phone numbers are BCD encoded however the nibbles are flipped. For example if you had a phone number such as 250-796-1586 it would be sent as 527-069-5168. This is why I had to manually flip them and used the `proto_tree_add_text_internal` function.

You can use proto_tree_add_item with ENC_BCD_DIGITS_0_9.

And the use of proto_tree_add_text_internal() is kind of forbidden as you cannot filter the items. You can control the output using the proto_tree_add_XXX_format_value() functions.
This was just for my understanding that the pointer is -> operator is equivalent to the pointer for that instance. Will delete.
Good call, `hf_ansi_tcap_parameter_business_group_length_LP11` is only looking at one bit
Do you mean the indenting of `&hf_ansi_tcap_parameter_business_group_length_Party_Selector` ?
No, you typed avalibility instead of availability
For 1 bit long fields,true_false_string is more appropriate than value_string
The bitmap is useless in that case

Thanks for the patch. You should also generate the ANSI TCAP dissector and add the packet-ansi-tcap.c file.
Please also update the commit message so as to look like:

ANSI TCAP: add national code dissection
